warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.style: Blocks to build Valor, then hits hard.
warrior.about: Blocks to build Valor, then spends it on hard hits and walls of steel, or holds it for a harder swing.

meter.name: Valor
meter.text: Valor builds when you Block a blow, more from a wound-up one.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.text: Heals as it fights and wears the enemy down.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.text: Hits harder and takes more for it.

knight.name: Knight
knight.text: More defense, and what hits it gets hurt.

mage.name: Magician
mage.style: Mana Shield, weak staff, strong spells.
mage.about: Block is a Mana Shield: half of each blow is paid in mana. Weak staff, strong magic, and mana is everything.

meter.name: Arcana
meter.text: Arcana builds a point every round.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.text: Fire: huge hits that leave the target burning.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.text: Heals itself and strikes with holy light.

spellsword.name: Spellsword
spellsword.text: Ice or lightning in every melee hit.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.style: Three quick hits, and crits that build.
rogue.about: Quick and fragile. Attack strikes three times, and every hit raises the crit chance until it crits.

meter.name: Mischief
meter.text: Mischief builds each time you attack.

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.text: Strikes first and can always get away.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.text: Takes one blow in full, then almost nothing can touch it.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.text: Poison on the blade, and better potions.

ranger.name: Hunter
ranger.style: Bows only, strikes first, shoots back.
ranger.about: Bows only. Often shoots back when struck, strikes first, and is at its best when it reads what comes next.

meter.name: Aim
meter.text: Aim builds when a blow misses you and when you crit.

trapper.name: Trapper
trapper.text: Reads what comes next and has a trap waiting.
